builtin.description: Puppeteer's own data, as {tools} tools: notes, todos, past sessions (search and read), projects and repos, the project's file tree and git, Slack threads the app saved, the Skills and Rules library, managed VPS and cloud accounts, dev servers, the code index, and schedule proposals.
builtin.purpose: Lets the AI use what you keep in Puppeteer without pasting it into the prompt: recall an earlier session, write a note or todo, look up a rule, run a command on a managed server.
builtin.googleDescription: Drive (drive_*): list, search, read, upload, share, delete files. Sheets (sheets_*): read any tab, edit individual cells, append rows. Gmail (mail_*): search, read, attachments, send, reply, labels. Calendar (cal_*): view events, check free slots, create and update meetings — as {tools} tools.
builtin.googlePurpose: Lets the AI work with your Google Drive, Sheets, Gmail and Calendar through the accounts you connect. Off by default because it reaches your mail and files: it is injected only once you switch it on and connect at least one Google account (Google settings).

empty.title: No MCP servers yet
empty.hint: Define an MCP server once, then enable it per project

list.claudeOnlyTitle: SSE transport is only supported by Claude. Codex runs will skip this server.

confirmDelete.title: Delete MCP server
confirmDelete.message: Delete MCP server "{name}"? This also removes its stored secrets. This cannot be undone.

list.noSelection: Select an MCP server, or create a new one
list.newManualHint: Fill in the form field by field
list.newAiHint: Paste setup instructions or a README link

editor.name: Name
editor.descriptionPlaceholder: What this server provides and what you use it for
editor.sseWarning: SSE is Claude-only; Codex runs support stdio and streamable HTTP.
editor.storedTitle: A value is stored; leave blank to keep it

validation.nameFormat: Name may only contain letters, numbers, hyphens, and underscores
validation.valueRequired: Fill in the value of "{key}", like: {hint}

detail.duplicated: Secret values aren't copied — fill them in before saving
detail.sourceBuiltin: Added by the app itself — not a server you created, and not synced from Claude Code or Codex.
detail.builtinHint: Injected at run launch, not stored as a server — it can be turned off but not deleted.
detail.perProjectHint: Turn it off for a single project in that project's MCP tab. When it is off here, it is off for every project. Takes effect on the next run.
detail.addHint: Adds it with empty secret values; finish the setup here.
detail.generalHint: Define an MCP server once, then enable it per project from the project's page.
detail.secretsHint: Values live in the OS Keychain and are never shown; leave a stored one blank to keep it.

confirmDiscard.title: Discard changes?
confirmDiscard.message: This MCP server has unsaved changes. Discard them?

detail.enabledHint: Applies right away; turn it off to keep it out of every new run.
detail.enabledHintDraft: Whether the server starts enabled once saved.
detail.testHint: Checks the server with the current settings — no need to save first.

aiAdd.title: Add with AI
aiAdd.hint: Paste an MCP server's setup instructions: a config block, an install command, or a README link (GitHub, npm). Whichever tool they were written for.
aiAdd.placeholder: For example: a JSON config block, an install command, or https://github.com/…/…
aiAdd.privacy: Known formats are read right here. Only text they miss goes to the AI, with tokens masked first.
aiAdd.runOnHint: Used only when no known format matches. Starts on the defaults in Settings (engine, its model, the default account); a change here applies to this request only.
aiAdd.none: No MCP server found. Paste the part with the install command or the config block.
aiAdd.pick: Found {count} servers — pick one to open as a draft:
aiAdd.draftReady: Form filled in — type the blank values, then Test connection and Save
aiAdd.draftByAi: The AI filled in the form — check each field, type the blank values, then Test connection and Save

slackDm.title: Slack DM threads
slackDm.globalHint: Off by default. Lets Slack threads in direct messages be added and fetched. Each project then turns it on for itself in its MCP tab. The Slack token also needs im:history (group DMs: mpim:history).
slackDm.checking: Checking each Slack token for the DM scopes…
slackDm.noTokens: No Slack token to check: no Slack MCP server is on.

status.missing: missing {scopes}: DM threads will fail until the token has it
status.unknown: Slack did not list the token's scopes, so this cannot be told
status.token_error: the token could not be checked (refused, revoked, or Slack did not answer)

connector.hint: A connector of a claude.ai account. Its setup lives on claude.ai, so there is nothing to edit, test or export here.
connector.notFound: Its profile's last connector check did not report it: runs leave it out until it is found again.
connector.enabledHint: Off here keeps it out of every run. On: it still needs to be on for the Project and the Session. Only runs of its own Claude profile get it; Codex runs never do.

discovery.globalHint: Every MCP server set up on this machine outside Puppeteer: Claude and Codex config files, claude.ai connectors, plugins, managed settings and other apps. A Puppeteer run loads only the servers managed here; every other one is blocked. Import one to manage it (it starts off).
discovery.projectHint: Every MCP server a run in this Project could load: the Project's own config files and the global ones. A run loads only the servers Puppeteer manages (switch them on in the card above); every other one is blocked.
discovery.blockedTitle: Servers a run would load that Puppeteer does not manage (other apps not counted): they are blocked in every run.
discovery.reloadTitle: Read every config again and check the claude.ai connectors of each Claude profile
discovery.loadFailed: Could not list the MCP servers found outside Puppeteer: {error}
discovery.empty: No MCP server found outside Puppeteer.
discovery.probeFailed: Could not check this profile's claude.ai connectors: {message}. None of its connectors can be used in runs.
discovery.openTitle: Open the managed copy in the MCP list
discovery.changedNotice: Its source changed since the import. Sync copies the source over again; the on/off switches stay as they are.
discovery.blockedNotice: Listed and blocked: this kind of server cannot be imported.

conflictTitle.C1: This profile and {others} are the same claude.ai login. Each keeps its own connectors and switches; nothing is merged.
conflictTitle.C2: This account and {others} are the same claude.ai login. Each keeps its own connectors and switches; nothing is merged.
conflictTitle.C3: Another MCP server is already named {key}: runs leave this connector out. Rename one of them.
conflictTitle.C4: This profile's claude.ai login could not be read, so a shared login cannot be checked.
